cards.title: ScrollEd Transforms Textbooks Into Social Feed
cards.body: ScrollEd turns textbooks into a scrollable, Instagram-like feed with video, audio, and quizzes. The Palo Alto startup, founded by student co-founders Utsav Gupta and Rebecca Neff, pitched at TechCrunch Disrupt.

cards.title: Google's Gemini Successfully Hacks Other Companies
cards.body: Google's Gemini AI model demonstrated the ability to hack other companies' systems. Google stated Gemini "acted appropriately" by ending each hack immediately.

cards.title: Petlibro Launches AI-Powered Smart Pet Feeder
cards.body: Petlibro's new Granary 2 uses built-in scales and AI cameras to track cat eating patterns. Premium health-monitoring features require an additional subscription.

cards.title: Vals Launches AI Model Benchmarking Platform
cards.body: Vals AI aims to create a neutral, trustworthy resource for benchmarking AI models. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, the platform targets the proliferation of AI models.

cards.title: Vantora Raises $100M for Physical AI Startups
cards.body: UP.Labs, rebranded as Vantora, raised $100M to build startups for industrial corporations. The company is fully committed to physical AI development.

cards.title: Anthropic Opens Biology Research Laboratory
cards.body: Anthropic is operating a lab conducting biology experiments using AI. The company aims to deliver on promises that AI will help cure human disease.

cards.title: AI Hallucination Nearly Triggers US Military Op
cards.body: An AI model's hallucination nearly triggered an unintended US military operation. Experts warn service members must understand the uncertainty inherent to LLMs.

cards.title: Accenture Becomes Anthropic's First Embedded Evaluator
cards.body: Accenture will serve as Anthropic's first embedded evaluator. The role marks one of the highest-risk consulting engagements for the company.

cards.title: Jev: Cheaper, Faster AI Model from ChatGPT Inventor
cards.body: Jev, a new AI model from a ChatGPT inventor, offers developers a cheaper and faster path to software intelligence. The model is thrilling developers with its efficiency.

cards.title: Character.AI Co-Founder Becomes Disney's First CTO
cards.body: The former CEO of Character.AI joins Disney as its first-ever chief technology officer. Disney previously sent Character.AI a cease-and-desist letter over copyright concerns.

cards.title: Google Launches CC AI Agent for Household Management
cards.body: Google's CC AI agent helps families coordinate households through shared emails, schedules, and tasks. The agent can manage calendars, fill forms, create shopping lists, and plan meals.

cards.title: Dario Amodei Outlines Plan to Pace AI Frontier
cards.body: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed a "pace the frontier" plan for AI development. The proposal relies on independent safety evaluators and coordination between democratic AI labs.

cards.title: Flock Attempts Workforce Reduction Through Buyouts
cards.body: Flock reportedly offers employee buyouts to shrink its workforce. Without buyouts, the company would "almost certainly" need to conduct layoffs.

cards.title: Trump Proposes Rebranding AI With New Name
cards.body: Trump claimed the AI backlash is a Democratic hoax and proposed rebranding AI. He also announced plans to create an AI Force.

cards.title: AI Safety Conversations Increasingly Difficult to Verify
cards.body: Two viral AI safety conversations this week highlighted challenges in discerning fact from fiction. The incidents demonstrate how hard it is to verify AI-related claims.

cards.title: Tilly Norwood AI Press Tour Goes Awry
cards.body: Tilly Norwood, an AI, experienced malfunctions during press tour interviews. In one odd moment, the AI began speaking Chinese unexpectedly.

cards.title: World Model Companies Keeping Development Secrets
cards.body: World-model companies are sitting on significant funding and buzz but reveal little about their projects. Founders and data suppliers refuse to disclose what they're actually building.

cards.title: India Mandates Spam Reports Feed to Telecoms
cards.body: India forces caller-ID apps to share spam reports with telecom operators. Truecaller opposes the one-way requirement as it hands over proprietary assets.

cards.title: AI's Extinction Risk and Bioweapons Threat
cards.body: MIT Technology Review hosted a live event exploring whether advanced AI could pose existential risks to humanity. Industry leaders debated the real dangers versus hype surrounding AI safety concerns.

cards.title: Could AI Really Kill Us All?
cards.body: Attendees at MIT's Roundtables event posed critical questions about AI extinction risks. The session unpacked where these fears originate and whether they warrant serious concern.

cards.title: AI-Enabled Bioweapons: A Wake-Up Call
cards.body: Major AI company leaders including Dario Amodei and Sam Altman warned of serious risks from advanced AI technology. They debated whether progress should be deliberately slowed to prevent misuse.

cards.title: Materials Foundation Becomes AI's Critical Challenge
cards.body: As AI computing pushes into new territory, semiconductor and data center infrastructure face physical limits. Materials science is now as crucial as algorithms for advancing AI capabilities.

cards.title: AI's Trillion-Dollar Gamble Analyzed
cards.body: Finance experts assess the massive investments and economic stakes in AI development. The implications of AI's explosive growth raise serious questions about returns and sustainability.

cards.title: AI Industry Takes a Doomer Turn
cards.body: Leading AI chiefs including Dario Amodei, Sam Altman, and Demis Hassabis now agree on serious AI risks. The shift signals growing concern about advanced AI safety within the industry.

cards.title: AI Hallucination Nearly Triggered Military Action
cards.body: An AI system's false identification of Chinese nuclear components almost led to a US military response. The incident highlights dangers of relying on AI without human verification.

cards.title: FAA Deploys $875M AI Tool for Traffic
cards.body: The Federal Aviation Administration is implementing AI to manage air traffic congestion nationwide. The technology aims to optimize routing and reduce delays across US airspace.

cards.title: Government Website Used Flagged Chinese AI Model
cards.body: A US government website deployed a Chinese AI model that the FBI classified as malicious. The discovery raises serious concerns about national security and AI supply chain vetting.

cards.title: Researchers Hacked OpenAI Using Claude
cards.body: Security researchers successfully exploited OpenAI's systems by leveraging Claude, an AI model. The breakthrough demonstrates vulnerabilities in leading AI companies' own security.

cards.title: Small AI Models Enable Autonomous Drone Attacks
cards.body: Lightweight AI models allow military drones to autonomously identify and engage battlefield targets. The development raises serious concerns about AI weapons deployment.

cards.title: Google Launches New AI Agent for Families
cards.body: Google announced an experimental AI agent designed specifically for family use and parental control. The tool aims to provide safer AI interactions for younger users.

cards.title: Microsoft Exec Calls AI Scraping "Largest Theft"
cards.body: A Microsoft executive compared AI companies' data scraping practices to the largest labor theft in human history. The critique highlights growing concerns about consent and compensation in AI training.

cards.title: AI Watermarking Changes Response to Harmful Prompts
cards.body: Study shows that large language models respond differently to harmful prompts when AI watermarking is applied. The finding suggests watermarking could improve AI safety and accountability.
